description: Bornes d'eau potable sur Rennes Métropole is a dataset listed in Rennes-metropole open data portal, an open data portal (Opendatasoft) of a region, department, metropolitan area or agency, published or maintained by Rennes Métropole. Cette couche localise les points d'eau potable sur l'espace public sur le territoire de Rennes Métropole. Coverage: Rennes Métropole. The portal files it under Espace public. Its keywords are eau potable, fontaine. The portal shows 38 records. It carries geographic features and can be exported as GeoJSON, KML or Shapefile. The portal shows 2025-06-19 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support drinking water network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ods-data-rennesmetropole-fr-portal.
